scope.title: EvidencePack Collection Scope
scope.description: Defines the scope for the EvidencePack: what evidence will be collected, why, by whom, where, and under which constraints.
objectives: Collect and preserve all relevant digital evidence related to Incident ABC for forensic analysis.
Ensure chain-of-custody and access controls are maintained for all collected items.
Provide a curated evidence set sufficient for internal investigation and potential legal proceedings.
evidenceTypes: cloud service artifacts (storage, compute, auth logs)

retentionPolicy.justification: Preserve for legal and regulatory review
retentionPolicy.secureDeletionProcedure: Overwrite and cryptographic erase according to org policy

constraints: No evidence may be altered or modified during acquisition.
Collection must minimize disruption to business operations.
Cross-jurisdictional data transfers require Legal sign-off.
assumptions: Requested systems are accessible to investigators.
Necessary credentials and approvals will be provided prior to collection.
acceptanceCriteria: All required evidence types listed above are present in the EvidencePack.
All items include cryptographic hashes and chain-of-custody records.
Legal has reviewed and approved any cross-border data movements.
